user.title: Connect your CarLinko account
user.description: Use a second CarLinko account authorised on your vehicle if possible — logging in here can sign you out of the official app on the primary account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your CarLinko password
reauth_confirm.description: CarLinko rejected the stored password for {email}. Enter the current one.

error.account_not_found: No CarLinko account with that email in this region — check the email, or try another region (e.g. emea, sea).
error.no_vehicles: No vehicle found on this account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant log for details.

data_description.transport_mode: Cloud only uses the CarLinko cloud. Bluetooth and cloud uses Bluetooth when the vehicle is in range of a Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter and falls back to the cloud when it is out of range. Bluetooth only never uses the cloud — for when the cloud account is not enabled. Sensors never go backwards: a reading is only accepted if its odometer is at least the last one seen.
